recipe.criteria: Chest supported on 45-degree bench, feet stable, neutral dumbbell grip, elbows slightly bent. Raise arms laterally to shoulder height, pause and lower without torso swing. 3.5 seconds lift, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
